0.original: Vuyargur wishes for there to be light.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Speak with the Yok Huy mountaineer in Solace.

25.original: Deliver the restoration glowstone to Vuyargur.

48.original: We Yok Huy use glowstone as a source of light in our homes, and we wish to employ it at the altar as well.

49.original: As the stone lies deep in the earth alongside fossilized matter, however, we must rely on seasoned mountaineers for its location and excavation.

50.original: I have tasked one such individual with the work to the north of Worlar's Echo. Might I trouble you to pay him a visit to see if he has found anything for us?

51.original: I have tasked our mountaineer with excavating glowstone again. Might I trouble you to pay him another visit to see if he has found anything for us?

52.original: As before, he should be performing his work to the north of Worlar's Echo. The way can be treacherous, so do take care with your footing.

53.original: Vuyargur sent you to collect the glowstone, did he? Here, take this.

54.original: That there is an exceptionally pure example, far rarer than what was requested and laborious to find. But in view of your efforts to restore peace to our land, I render it up gladly.

55.original: Ah, it's you again. Here for the glowstone, I take it. You may take this with you.

56.original: Should Vuyargur require more, I should be glad to provide. These old bones may creak more than they used to, but I consider it my little way of contributing to the cause.

57.original: I am counting on your success─we all are.

58.original: Did the mountaineer have glowstone for us?

59.original: Well now, this is a fine specimen indeed, of a quality befitting ceremonial use. It is very generous of him to yield such.

60.original: Perhaps you already know this, but we Yok Huy have a ritual whereby we prolong the radiance of glowstone by sprinkling it with saltwater imbued with prayers.

61.original: We Yok Huy have a tradition whereby we prolong the radiance of glowstone by sprinkling it with saltwater imbued with prayers.

62.original: Those prayers harbor the desire for our lives to endure in serenity, like the stone's gentle glow.

63.original: I shall pray for the same as I put this glowstone to use in our work. My thanks for the delivery, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.
